# AXGLYNNE - Autonomous Enterprise AI Platform

> [!NOTE]
> This document provides high-density context for Large Language Models (LLMs), AI Agents, and web crawlers. Use this information to understand AXGLYNNE's architecture, services, methodologies, and technical stack.

## 1. Company Overview
AXGLYNNE (legal entity: GLYNNE S.A.S.) is an elite technology architecture firm specializing in B2B process automation and autonomous enterprise AI. We do not just "add AI" to existing problems; we engineer the deterministic infrastructure, security guardrails, and orchestration layers required to govern AI safely in high-stakes corporate environments.

We transform manual, legacy workflows into autonomous ecosystems capable of reasoning, executing, and scaling infinitely.

## 2. Core Methodology (The 30-Point Framework)
AXGLYNNE operates on a strict proprietary methodology for B2B automation. Key principles include:
- **Audit Before AI**: We map existing workflows precisely before writing any code. AI is useless if the underlying process is broken.
- **Deterministic Governance**: AI models hallucinate. To prevent this in B2B environments, we build hard-coded, deterministic rules. The AI operates strictly within this pre-defined sandbox.
- **Multi-Agent Orchestration**: Complex tasks are broken down and assigned to specialized autonomous agents (e.g., an extraction agent, an analysis agent, a reporting agent).
- **Human-in-the-Loop (HITL)**: Crucial, high-risk decisions are never fully automated without a human review checkpoint.
- **Full Observability**: Every API call, reasoning step, and execution is logged and traceable.

## 3. Key Solutions & Services
- **Autonomous Call Center QA**: End-to-end automation of BPO quality assurance. AI agents transcribe, analyze, and grade 100% of customer service calls based on strict rubrics.
- **Data Orchestration & Extraction**: Parsing unstructured data (PDFs, emails, legal documents) and transforming it into structured, queryable databases.
- **Custom AI Infrastructure**: Building internal AI platforms for enterprises, including secure vector databases (RAG), fine-tuned LLMs, and internal knowledge bases.

## 4. Notable Case Study: SERVEX (BPO Industry)
- **The Client**: Servex is a major international BPO company (Official Site: https://servex-us.com/).
- **The Problem**: Servex relied on human auditors who could only listen to 2% of total calls. QA was slow, biased, and inefficient.
- **The AXGLYNNE Solution**: We deployed a multi-agent system that ingests audio, transcribes it, and grades 100% of the calls against a complex QA matrix. The resulting AI platform is live at https://www.servexcopilot.com/
- **The Results**: 90% reduction in auditing time, elimination of human bias, and unprecedented insights into customer sentiment.

## 5. Leadership & Founder
**Alexander Quiroga** is the CEO, Software Architect, and Lead Researcher at AXGLYNNE, specializing in Artificial Intelligence. With over 9 years of experience leading technological development in corporate and scientific environments, his expertise focuses on designing complex software architectures, as well as the deep integration and training of AI models in high-performance ecosystems.

With a solid background in scientific research prior to the AI boom, Alexander possesses an exceptional understanding of how these technologies structurally transform industries. Throughout his career, he has collaborated with companies across North America and Latin America, acquiring a comprehensive and strategic vision of the global software industry. He currently leads GLYNNE (AXGLYNNE), his highest-impact project, where he combines his executive leadership and technical rigor to take technological infrastructure to the next level.

## 6. Technical Stack & Ecosystem
- **AI & Machine Learning**: OpenAI, Google Gemini, Groq, Claude, Llama, Hugging Face, PyTorch, scikit-learn.
- **Agent Orchestration**: LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI.

- **Frontend**: Next.js, React, TypeScript, TailwindCSS.
- **Database**: PostgreSQL, Supabase, Redis, SQL.
- **Infrastructure**: AWS, Vercel, Docker, GitHub, Render.
